twitchRewardIds.title: Twitch reward IDs
twitchRewardIds.description: Right-click the reward in Streamer.bot and choose Copy Reward Id. Turn on "Require viewer to enter text" so viewers can type their question.

kickRewardIds.title: Kick reward IDs
kickRewardIds.description: Copy the Kick reward ID the same way. Kick rewards have no cooldown of their own; every redemption gets an answer.

command.title: Chat command (optional)
command.description: For example ask, so viewers type !ask will I win? Leave empty for rewards only. If you choose 8ball, turn off the 8-Ball command in Village Fun Commands.

commandPlatforms.title: Chats that can use the command

answers.title: Your own answers (optional)
answers.description: One answer per row. Leave empty to use the 18 built-in answers.

avoidRepeats.title: Never give the same answer twice in a row

noQuestionMessage.title: Answer when a reward has no question

cooldownMessage.title: Cooldown message
cooldownMessage.default: {viewer}, the 8-Ball is resting. Ask again in {seconds}s.

showOverlay.title: Show the question and answer on the overlay
